key_based_merge.details: Merged features and relay on ['date', 'code'] explicitly, resolving 173 code and 91 board positional mismatches in September 2026.

formal_target_integration.details: Adopted formal target with 9,178 known and 67 unknown rows (incorporating 133 legitimate historical mature outcomes previously omitted by raw promoted_next_day).

full_denominator_disclosure.details: All tables and receipts now report N, known, unknown, success, known_rate, lower_bound (k/N), upper_bound ((k+unknown)/N), and Wilson 95% on known.

first_board_scope_correction.details: Corrected scope to 2025-07-01 to 2026-08-31 (286 trading dates, 13,149 rows: 13,047 known, 102 unknown; non-one-price: 12,844 rows: 12,743 known, 101 unknown).

cycle_height_change_full_range.details: Disclosed full distribution from -7 to +1; acknowledged that height<=-2 difference interval contains 0 ([-0.57pp, +6.60pp]) and does not satisfy +5pp gate. Removed blanket break encouragement.

execution_proxy_terminology_and_denomina.details: Re-named '真实次日净收益' to 'S+1假设触板入场、S+2收盘退出的日线执行代理'. Disclosed observable denominators for large_loss (3,018 non-one-word, 1,016 one-word) and net_return (2,956 and 991). Clarified that failed promotion with proxy is not the entire failed population.

verified_turnover_boards_definition.details: Corrected definition: it counts historical turnover nodes in the streak, not current board height (527 of 4,964 are board=3, 205 are board=4). Deleted invalid gate 'verified_turnover_boards == 2 && EBB_HANDOVER' from first-board design.

turnover_monotonicity_correction.details: Withdrew 'strictly monotonic' claim (dips from <3% 16.12% to 3-5% 14.64%). Disclosed that turnover fields are already part of BASE 62 features.

auction_constraint_removal.details: Removed requirement that 09:25 call auction is mandatory to be positive Top1 in S 15:00 close evaluation.
